formalResultRule: Only Android may create FormalTrainingResult after durable local transaction commit.
batchEligibilityRule: Only closed=true and decisionEligible=true batches affect score, levels and nextStartLevel.
durableIntakeRule: For active messages, canonical message row, sender high-water marks and post-message A620-RSN-1.1 reducer snapshot must commit in one local transaction; exact replay is idempotent, conflicting reuse is fatal, and stale execution/runtime/epoch is audit-only.
pauseDeadlinePriorityRule: effectivePauseUptimeMs must be strictly less than cutoffUptimeMs; DEADLINE wins at equal uptime.
activeRuntimeReplacementRule: runtimeSessionId is never reused; replacing the same task item requires a strictly greater executionAttempt.
